name: Maggotkin of Nurgle - Cycle of Corruption

abilities.name: Revolution and Revulsion
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: You must use this ability at the start of each battle round.
abilities.effect: If it is the first battle round, roll a dice to determine which Cycle ability is ripe for the rest of the battle round. 1 'Unnatural Fecundity' 2 'Fecund Vigour' 3 'Burgeoning Filth' 4 'Plague of Misery' 5 'Nauseous Revulsion' 6 'Rampant Disease' 7 'Corrupted Regrowth' If it is not the first battle round, the next Cycle ability in the sequence is ripe for the rest of the battle round. If the 'Corrupted Regrowth' ability was ripe last battle round, the 'Unnatural Vitality' ability is ripe this battle round. You can only use a Cycle ability if it is ripe. Only 1 Cycle ability is ripe each battle round.

abilities.name: Unnatural Vitality
abilities.effect: Friendly non-Monster Cycle of Corruption Heroes have Ward (4+).

abilities.name: Fecund Vigour
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Heal (D3) each friendly Cycle of Corruption unit.

abilities.name: Burgeoning Filth
abilities.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units wihle they are in combat with any friendly Cycle of Corruption units.

abilities.name: Plague of Misery
abilities.effect: While enemy units are within 12" of any friendly 'Cycle of Corruption' units, they cannot use abilities that heal or return slain models to a unit.

abilities.name: Nauseous Revulsion
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units.

abilities.name: Rampant Disease
abilities.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly non-Hero Cycle of Corruption units have Crit (2 Hits).

abilities.name: Corrupted Regrowth
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Heal (7) each friendly Feculent Gnarlmaw. If there are no friendly Feculent Gnarlmaws on the battlefield, you can set up a Feculent Gnarlmaw on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

powers.name: Epidermal Crustitis
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Cycle of Corruption Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target the caster.

powers.name: Rank and Vile
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Cycle of Corruption Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy Infantry unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain, after removing it from the battlefield, roll a dice. On a 4+, return 1 slain model to a friendly non-Hero Cycle of Corruption^^ unit within 6" of the target.

powers.name: Spittledrain
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Cycle of Corruption Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: Subtract 1 from the target's Move characteristic until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target, to a maximum of 7.

powers.name: Bacterial Blessing
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Cycle of Corruption Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Cycle of Corruption unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
powers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks. If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

powers.name: Ever Turning
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Cycle of Corruption Priest to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
powers.effect: The next Cycle ability in the sequence is ripe for the rest of the battle round instead of the current Cycle ability. If the chanting roll was 12+, you can pick which Cycle ability is ripe.

powers.name: Virulent Agonies
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Cycle of Corruption Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
powers.effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within the target's combat range, If the chanting roll was 7+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target instead of 1.

abilities.name: Scything Blade
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic in one direction (see 'The Pendulum Swings'). It can pass through models during that move and can end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move or that are within 1/2" of it to be the targets. Roll a D6 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Pendulum Swings
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot use Charge or Fight abilities. In addition, when this Manifestation moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing

summon.name: Summon Aethervoid Pendulum
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulumon the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Mechanisms of Time
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If there are any friendly Wizards within 3" of this Manifestation, pick 1 of the following effects: *Increase Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation. *Decrease Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly Wizards while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Chronomantic Cogs
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Chronomantic Cogs endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Chronomantic Cogs endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Dancing Blades
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this Manifestation's attacks.

summon.name: Summon Quicksilver Swords
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Quicksilver Swords endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Quicksilver Swords endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Harbinger of Horror
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this Manifestation's shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of models in the target unit that were slain this phase, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

summon.name: Summon Horrorghast
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Horrorghast endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Horrorghast endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Traverse the Tides of Death
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Infantry Wizard Hero within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield within 3" of this Manifestation and not in combat. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Lauchon the Soulseeker
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Phantasmal Translocation
abilities.effect: Pick a part of this Manifestation, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Ensnaring Soul-drain
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit uses a Move ability while it is within 9" of any parts of this Manifestation, the effects of the 'Fly' ability do not apply to that unit. Enemy units cannot be set up within 9" of either part of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Shards of Valagharr
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Shards of Valagharr endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Shards of Valagharr endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Shards of Valagharr endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Deathly Passage
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of one part of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the other part of this Manifestation and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

summon.name: Summon Soulscream Bridge
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulscream Bridge endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Soulscream Bridge wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulscream Bridge has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Devourer of Magics
abilities.effect: If this Manifestation destroyed any enemy Manifestations this turn, Heal (6) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Arcane Predator
abilities.effect: You can add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this Manifestation, to a maximum of 3, while it is within 18" of any enemy Manifestations, but if you do so, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of an enemy Manifestation.

abilities.name: Wild Form
abilities.effect: Each time this Manifestation is targeted by the 'Banish Manifestation' ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

summon.name: Summon Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Morbid Detonation
abilities.declare: You must, and can only, use this ability if this unit has 6 maelstrom points. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this Manifestation is destroyed.

abilities.name: Necrotic Vortex
abilities.effect: Give this Manifestation 1 maelstrom point each time: • This Manifestation is set up. • A unit successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this Manifestation. • A model is slain within 12" of this Manifestation. This Manifestation can have a maximum of 6 maelstrom points at once.

summon.name: Summon Malevolent Maelstrom
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: End Given Form
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Pull of the Nadir
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for friendly and enemy units while they are within 3" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Purple Sun of Shyish
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Purple Sun of Shyish endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Purple Sun of Shyish endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Bound for the Great Oubliette
abilities.declare: For each part of this Manifestation, you can pick an enemy unit within 3" of that part to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • Subtract a number of inches equal to the roll from the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

summon.name: Summon Soulsnare Shackles
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulsnare Shackles endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.

abilities.name: Pulled to the Grave
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can pick an enemy unit that this Manifestation passed across during that move to be the target. Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Suffocating Gravetide
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Suffocating Gravetide endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Suffocating Gravetide endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Tendrils of Light and Shadow
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are within 3" of either part of this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play. Each time this Manifestation moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other. Each part of this Manifestation is armed with Tendrils of Light and Shadow.

summon.name: Summon Geminids of Uhl-Gysh
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizardto cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Blinding Light
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot be targeted by shooting attacks. In addition, a unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks if it is impossible to draw a straight line from a model in the attacking unit to a model in the target unit without that line passing across this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Prismatic Palisade
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Prismatic Palisade endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Prismatic Palisade wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Arcane Passage
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Wizard within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: The next time the target uses a non-Summon Spell ability this phase, add 1 to the casting value of that spell. When picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from either part of this Manifestation instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to either part of this Manifestation instead of to the caster for the purposes of the 'Unbind' ability.

summon.name: Summon Umbral Spellportal
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Umbral Spellportal endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Umbral Spellportal wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. An Umbral Spellportal has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Restored Vigour
abilities.effect: Heal (3) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Bounteous Healing
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Heal (3) the target.

summon.name: Summon Emerald Lifeswarm
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Ravening Hunger
abilities.declare: If this Manifestation charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

weapons.name: Burning Breath
weapons.ability: Shoot in Combat, Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)

abilities.name: Burning Up
abilities.effect: Each time this Manifestation uses a Shoot ability, after that ability has been resolved, allocate 1 damage point to this Manifestation (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point).

abilities.name: Cankerous Nail
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Utterly Disgusting
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: Rot-Blossom
abilities.effect: Friendly Rotbringers units have Ward (5+) while they are wholly within 12" of this terrain feature.

abilities.name: Tendrils of Corruption
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, this terrain feature has a Move characteristic of 3" and can immediately move 3". It cannot move through or end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units and it cannot end that move on an objective or another terrain feature. Designer's Note: *This terrain feature cannot use* Move, Run*,* Retreat *or* Charge *abilities.*

abilities.name: Riddled With Disease
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle Daemon unit wholly within 12" of this terrain feature uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 1 additional rally roll of D6. If that unit is a non-Hero unit, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6 instead.

abilities.name: Ruptured Cysts
abilities.declare: Pick a visible Diseased enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on each other Diseased enemy unit within 3" of the target. If the chanting roll is 9+, you can also pick a friendly Plaguebearers unit within 12" of the target. For each enemy Infantry model slain by this ability this turn, you can return 1 slain model to that friendly unit.

abilities.name: Scry the Filth
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn: • Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle Wizards while they are within 3" of this unit. • Add 1 to chanting rolls for friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle Priests while they are within 3" of this unit.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Bilespurter's Claws is 3.

abilities.name: Daemon Flies
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Monster in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Miasma of Pestilence
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, other than the Companion ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target that friendly unit have no effect.

abilities.name: Scumboil Pox
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy Wizard or Priest within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the target's power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Delightful Brews, Splendid Restoratives
abilities.declare: Pick a visible unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: If the target is a friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle unit, Heal (D3) the target. If the target is an enemy unit, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Pestilential Beachhead
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is aboard the Slime Fleet.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield, wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then set up every other friendly unit that is aboard the Slime Fleet on the battlefield wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge, wholly within 7" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Flailing Tentacles
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Infantry Hero in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Master of the Slime Fleet
abilities.declare: Pick a regiment led by this unit to be the target if no units from that regiment have been deployed.
abilities.effect: Each unit in the target regiment is set up in reserve aboard the Slime Fleet. Those units have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Knell of Doom
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. If the target is within 6" of a friendly Sloven Knights unit, you can roll a D6 instead. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Control characteristic, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Omens of Decay
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Subtract twice the current battle round number from the target's control score for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 10+, this ability affects all enemy units within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Master of Rot Flies
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick this unit and up to 2 friendly Pusgoyle Blightlords units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the targets' Rot Fly's Mouthparts and Sting melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Vectors of Foulest Contagion
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Thrice-ripened Death's Heads
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit or with a friendly Plague Drones wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll D3. On 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Festering Bulwark
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and a friendly Putrid Blightkings unit within 3" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn

abilities.name: Sevenfold Slaughter
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Rotswords unit that did not charge this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's Ruined Master-crafted Weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Lord of the Infected Legions
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Rotswords units that did not charge this turn while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Tripletongue's Claws is 3.

abilities.name: Gigantic Nurgling-kin
abilities.effect: Heal (X) this unit, where X is half the number of damage points this unit has (rounding up).

abilities.name: Tide of Nurglings
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up tp 2 friendly Nurglings unit wholly within 12" of this unit's to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+: • If the target is not in combat, it can move a number of inches equal to the roll but cannot end that move in combat. • If the target is in combat, it can make a pile-in move.

abilities.name: Lord of Nurglings
abilities.effect: While any friendly Nurglings units are wholly within 12" of this unit: • Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to that **Nurglings* unit each phase. • That Nurglings unit can ignore the effect of the 'Beast' ability.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Whippermaw's Claws is 3.

abilities.name: Grasping Tongue
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle units that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Acid Ichor
abilities.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Tainted Sorceries
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was picked to be the target of a spell that was successfully cast by this unit this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from ward rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Purulent Profusion
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Rampant Defilement
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Pestigors unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Ghurk's Tentacle is 3.

abilities.name: Blighted Stampede
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared the 'Counter-charge' command for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick up to 2 friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. After the 'Counter-charge' command for this unit has been resolved, if this unit charged, each of the targets can immediately use the 'Counter-charge' command in an order of your choosing without any command points being spent.

abilities.name: Overgrowth of Flesh
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target's Health characteristic. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target, to a maximum of 7 mortal damage. If any mortal damage was inflicted on the target, and the target was not a Manifestation or terrain feature, it has the Diseased keyword.

abilities.name: Horrific Opponent
abilities.effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Tentacle Trap
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Hero or Monster in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, for the rest of the turn: • The target cannot move and cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow it to be set up elsewhere on the battlefield. • Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Bestial Desecration
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons while it is not within enemy territory.

abilities.name: Mire Kelpies
abilities.effect: This unit's Mire Kelpies are tokens. There are 6 Mire Kelpies for every 14 models in this unit.

abilities.name: Contagious Catarrh
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: If this unit has any Mire Kelpies, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. You cannot pick a Manifestation or terrain feature.
abilities.effect: Pick any number of this unit's Mire Kelpies and remove them from the battlefield. Then, roll a dice, adding 1 to the roll for each Mire Kelpie you removed this phase. On an unmodified roll of 1, this ability has no effect. On a 6+, the target has the Diseased keyword.

abilities.name: Relentless Attackers
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's Flyrider's Arsenal for attacks that target enemy units contesting an objective.

abilities.name: Dispersed Formation
abilities.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

abilities.name: Discomfiting Stench
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy Wizard or Priest within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. • If the target is a Wizard and the roll exceeds the target's power level, until the start of your next turn, each time a casting roll for the target includes 2 or more rolls of 1, 2 or more rolls of 2 or 2 or more rolls of 3, the spell is miscast. • If the target is a Priest and the roll exceeds the target's power level, until the start of your next turn, each time your opponent makes an unmodified chanting roll of 1 or 2 for the target, the prayer fails, its effect is not resolved and your opponent must remove D3 ritual points from the target. In addition, your opponent cannot give that Priest any ritual points for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Putrescent Piety
abilities.effect: This unit has Priest (1) for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Disgustingly Devoted
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, give this unit D3 ritual points.

abilities.name: Virulent Concoctions
abilities.effect: When picking an enemy unit to be the target of the 'infect' effect of the 'Blessed by the Plaguefather' ability, you can pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it by this unit's shooting attacks this turn to be the target, even if that unit is not within 7" of any friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle units. You cannot pick a Manifestation or terrain feature.

abilities.name: Sweat-Soaked and Reeking
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Pall of Exhaustion
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is in combat with any other friendly Rotbringers units. On a 3+, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Indolent Bludgeoning
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, while the target is in combat with both this unit and another friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle unit, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Retchling
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit's Fecula Flyblown is on the battlefield, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Fecula Flyblown
abilities.effect: While this unit's Fecula Flyblown is on the battlefield, it has Wizard (1).
